Notes:
- Scheduler timings include host-to-shared-buffer staging, one command-buffer
  submission and wait, device admission, and deterministic bin/cohort placement.
- Remote timings use authenticated loopback TCP to a distinct worker thread.
- Every remote trial changes logical epoch, preventing response-ledger cache hits.
- Full-publication timings create two collectives in a fresh kernel, execute the
  first remotely, spill the second to CPU, publish both, and assert one migration.
